title: Split the gate-allowed prefix list so a source edit stops without locking bee out of its own brief
action: Close the hole that lets the docs lane write freely at a gated phase, WITHOUT locking bee out of writing its own records (per D1 and D6). Today `GATE_ALLOWED_PREFIXES` in hooks/write_guard/guards.rs is `[".bee/", "docs/", "plans/", "AGENTS.md"]` and it is consumed in THREE places, so editing it in place is not a local change: (1) checks.rs's gated-phase boundary (search checks.rs for `is_gated_phase`, the branch that denies with 'gate "execution" is not approved'), (2) checks.rs's idle/terminal intake gate slightly above it, and (3) `worktree_first_exempt_rel` in hooks/write_guard/hook_local.rs. Verify all three consumers yourself before changing anything — the count may have shifted. SPLIT the constant into two named lists rather than editing the shared one: a GATED-PHASE list and an INTAKE list. The gated-phase list drops the blanket `docs/` and keeps only what bee itself must write before approval: `.bee/`, `docs/history/`, `plans/`, `AGENTS.md`. The intake list keeps today's full behavior including blanket `docs/`, because a docs-lane session at phase idle or a terminal phase must not be locked out. Leave hook_local.rs's worktree-first consumer on whichever list preserves its CURRENT behavior exactly — note it independently exempts every `*.md`, so it is not the enforcement point for anything here. The behavior that must change: at phase exploring or planning with execution unapproved, a write to `docs/` that is NOT under `docs/history/` now REFUSES, where today it passes. RED-FIRST: `hooks/write_guard/tests.rs` already pins the current behavior with a case asserting a `docs/plan.md` write at phase planning returns code 0 (search tests.rs for `gated_phase_denies_source_until_execution_approved`). That existing assertion is exactly what this cell changes, so update it deliberately and say so — do not delete it, retarget it to a path that is still allowed and add a new case for the path that now refuses.

truths: At phase exploring or planning with execution unapproved, a write under docs/history/ is allowed

A write under .bee/ is allowed at a gated phase exactly as before
At phase idle or a terminal phase, every path allowed today is still allowed, blanket docs/ included
The worktree-first exemption behaves exactly as it did before this cell
